interventions.title: Sidewalk Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the sidewalk to provide a smooth, level walking surface free of cracks and tripping hazards.

interventions.title: Installation of a Furniture Zone or Buffer
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island Expansion
interventions.description: Enlarge the median refuge island to provide a more substantial and protected waiting area for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Regular removal of debris and trash to ensure the full width of the sidewalk is usable and safe.

interventions.title: Crosswalk Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the degraded pavement in the crosswalk to ensure a smooth, level surface for all users, especially those with mobility aids.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Prune low-hanging branches to improve visibility between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching motorists.
